meta.title: Selection Quote & Comment
meta.description: Select text in conversation messages to Add to Chat (⌘L) or Add Comment (⇧⌘L), with a Quotes & Comments Dock right above the composer input box.

enabled.title: Enable Selection Quote & Comment
enabled.description: Whether to enable the floating selection toolbar and the Quotes & Comments Dock.

addToChatMode.title: Default Add to Chat (⌘L) Behavior
addToChatMode.description: Whether Add to Chat (⌘L) inserts the blockquote directly into the composer draft (direct) or appends it to the Quotes & Comments Dock (dock).

commentLabel.title: Comment Prefix Label
commentLabel.description: Label prefix used when formatting comments into Markdown (default: '批注').
